metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve a Tight Upper Back in 30 SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises to help instantly relieve upper back tightness, even in as little as 30 seconds.

These exercises focus on stretching and strengthening the main upper back muscles that cause discomfort, pain, and tightness for both quick and long-lasting relief. These muscles include the upper trapezius and levator scapulae.

To get the best results, go through all the exercises and use the ones that give the most relief.

Watch now and fix upper back pain and tightness fast!
